nodes.name: Basic Extraction Analytics
nodes.effect: +10% raw extraction throughput
nodes.description: Installs automated throughput monitoring and predictive calibration across all active extractor yards. Reduces waste cycles and improves output consistency.

nodes.name: Industrial Safety Protocols
nodes.effect: -8% facility downtime risk
nodes.description: Mandates standardized hazard containment procedures and automated shutdown trip lines across all facilities. Reduces the probability of unplanned extraction outages.

nodes.name: Supply Forecast Engine
nodes.effect: -6% extractor build cost, +6% mining yield
nodes.description: Deploys a predictive resource flow model across your logistics network. Reduces extractor construction costs by 6% and improves mining yield by 6%.

nodes.name: High-Density Energy Routing
nodes.effect: Unlocks Material Compression I, Containment Physics I, Fleet Coordination Matrix and Assembly & Fabrication Systems
nodes.description: Redesigns power distribution architecture to support higher-load research and production lines. Gate technology for Material Compression, Containment Physics, Fleet Coordination and Assembly & Fabrication research.

nodes.name: Material Compression I
nodes.effect: Unlocks Nickel refining, and (with further research) the Silicates and Titanium chains
nodes.description: Applies high-pressure compression staging to raw silicate and metal inputs before refinery processing. Gates Nickel refining outright, and the Silicates and Titanium chains alongside Nano-Lattice Weaving or High-Density Energy Routing.

nodes.name: Light-Metal Electrolysis
nodes.effect: Unlocks the Aluminium, Aluminium-Lithium and Battery chains
nodes.description: Molten-salt electrolysis cells for the light metals: Bauxite reduced to aluminium, aluminium alloyed with Lithium, and Lithium and Cobalt made into battery cells. The Light Metals track (docs/design/tier3-recipes.md, AB#833).

nodes.name: Nano-Lattice Weaving
nodes.effect: Unlocks Aerogel and Quantum Insulator refinery chains
nodes.description: Licenses nano-scale lattice assembly techniques from the Pan-System Research Compact. Required for Aerogel and Quantum Insulator output from silicate chains.

nodes.name: Ferrous Metallurgy
nodes.effect: Unlocks the Nickel-Iron smelting and Pressure Vessel refinery chains
nodes.description: Blast-free reduction of iron ore with belt nickel into a Nickel-Iron alloy, and the forging of that alloy into pressure vessels. The metals half of the v0.8 production tracks.

nodes.name: Containment Physics I
nodes.effect: Unlocks the Helium-3 and cryogenics refinery chains
nodes.description: Establishes magnetic confinement field generation standards. Required before Helium-3 can be safely processed into Plasma Conduits at refinery scale.

nodes.name: Fusion Fuel Cycle
nodes.effect: Unlocks the fusion-fuel refinery chain: Helium-3 and Deuterium into Fusion Pellets
nodes.description: Licenses the deuterium-helium-3 pellet process the Lunar Helium Consortium's reactors burn. Required before Helium-3 and Deuterium can be pressed into Fusion Pellets at refinery scale.

nodes.name: Exotic Energy Routing
nodes.effect: Unlocks Dark-Matter Capacitor synthesis
nodes.description: Extends power routing standards to handle exotic-state matter demands. Gate technology for Dark-Matter Capacitor production from processed Helium-3.

nodes.name: Fleet Coordination Matrix
nodes.effect: +12 fleet cap. Light Fighters and Attack Troops need it
nodes.description: Integrates command-layer coordination software across all vessel classes. Expands the effective fleet size your corporation can sustain in active deployment.

nodes.name: Capital Hull Engineering
nodes.effect: Unlocks Destroyer construction at the Orbital Shipyard
nodes.description: Armoured line-ship hulls with point-defence flak, built on titanium-chain Armour Plating. Destroyers screen a fleet against fighters and are the backbone of a raid or a garrison.

nodes.name: Siege Ordnance
nodes.effect: Unlocks Siege Engine construction at the Orbital Shipyard
nodes.description: Heavy mass-driver platforms on Pressure Vessel frames: slow, but able to break an entrenched garrison.

nodes.name: Fire-Control Computers
nodes.effect: +10% accuracy for every unit in battle
nodes.description: Predictive targeting that leads a moving hull. Raises the share of every shot that lands, the one lever beyond the counters in a deterministic battle (docs/design/v0.10-combat.md). Planned: no battle is fought until v0.10's raids, so it cannot be queued yet.

nodes.name: Evasive Manoeuvres
nodes.effect: +10% evasion for every unit in battle
nodes.description: Drilled jinking patterns and decoy emitters. Lowers the share of every enemy shot that lands (docs/design/v0.10-combat.md). Planned: no battle is fought until v0.10's raids, so it cannot be queued yet.

nodes.name: Near-Star Navigation Array
nodes.effect: Enables travel to Alpha Centauri, Barnard's Star, Lalande 21185 and Ross 154
nodes.description: Commissions a calibrated navigation array tuned to the nearest stellar neighbours. Required before any vessel in your fleet can plot an interstellar course to Alpha Centauri, Barnard's Star, Lalande 21185 or Ross 154.

nodes.name: Deep-Star Cartography Suite
nodes.effect: Enables travel to Wolf 359, Tau Ceti, Epsilon Eridani, Sirius, Ross 248, Luyten 726-8 and Lacaille 9352
nodes.description: Deploys a full deep-space cartography suite capable of plotting routes across the local stellar neighbourhood. Unlocks Wolf 359, Tau Ceti, Epsilon Eridani, Sirius, Ross 248, Luyten 726-8 and Lacaille 9352; the systems beyond them need Long-Baseline Jump Plotting.

nodes.name: Long-Baseline Jump Plotting
nodes.effect: Enables travel to Procyon, Ross 128, 61 Cygni, Kapteyn's Star and Epsilon Indi
nodes.description: Extends the cartography suite's baseline across the nearest dozen light years, so a jump can be plotted past the Deep-Star systems. Opens the Long-Baseline systems of docs/design/starmap-20.md.

nodes.name: Frontier Cartography
nodes.effect: Enables travel to Kruger 60, Wolf 1061, Altair, 70 Ophiuchi and van Maanen's Star
nodes.description: Charts the frontier of the neighbourhood, where the richest belts and the fewest authorities are. Opens the Frontier systems of docs/design/starmap-20.md.

nodes.name: Assembly & Fabrication Systems
nodes.effect: Unlocks Assembly Facility construction
nodes.description: Licenses modular assembly line blueprints from the Pan-System Engineering Bureau. Required before your corporation can construct an Assembly Facility capable of manufacturing units such as mining probes, drones, and defensive platforms.

nodes.name: Asteroid Prospecting Arrays
nodes.effect: Unlocks Mining Probe fabrication, scouting asteroid belts and launching expeditions
nodes.description: Deploys long-range mineral scanning arrays and autonomous probe guidance firmware. Enables the Assembly Facility to fabricate Mining Probes, the arrays to scout an asteroid belt's composition, and expeditions to be launched to a belt.

nodes.name: Rare-Metal Separation
nodes.effect: Unlocks the Rare-Earth Magnet and Thorium Fuel Rod refinery chains
nodes.description: Licenses solvent-extraction and ion-exchange separation from the Pan-System Research Compact, splitting rare earths, cobalt and thorium to the purity magnets and reactor fuel demand. Thorium Fuel Rods also need Containment Physics I.

nodes.name: Integrated Manufacturing
nodes.effect: Unlocks the four cross-track chains: Fusion Reactor Cores, Compact Fission Modules, Lightweight Spaceframes and Ion Thrusters
nodes.description: Combines the products of the fuel, metals, rare-metal and light-metal lines into finished assemblies. It licenses the assembly, not the lines behind it: the inputs can be bought from whoever makes them.

nodes.name: Actinide Handling
nodes.effect: Unlocks Uranium: without it, an expedition or an extractor recovers none of the Uranium it digs
nodes.description: Shielded handling and remote assay for the actinides. Belts past Sol carry Uranium in their ore; until a corporation can handle it, its share of the haul is left in the tailings.

nodes.name: Deep-Core Extraction
nodes.effect: Unlocks Platinum-Group Metals: without it, an expedition or an extractor recovers none of the Platinum-Group Metals it digs
nodes.description: Bore-hole mining under the crater floors and lava plains of exotic-system worlds, where the platinum-group metals sit below the iron.

nodes.name: Deep-Atmosphere Extraction
nodes.effect: Unlocks Metallic Hydrogen: without it, an expedition or an extractor recovers none of the Metallic Hydrogen it digs
nodes.description: Pressure-hulled skimmers that drop below a gas giant's cloud decks to the layers where hydrogen turns metallic, and hold it there on the way up.

nodes.name: High-Energy Synthesis
nodes.effect: Unlocks the Synthesis Array, the one building that makes Tier 4 products
nodes.description: Particle-beam and plasma-forge synthesis at energies no refinery reaches. It licenses the Synthesis Array; each Tier 4 product also needs the research for its exotic input.

nodes.name: Exotic Containment
nodes.effect: Unlocks Exotic Matter: without it, an expedition or an extractor recovers none of the Exotic Matter it digs
nodes.description: Field-stabilised containment for matter that does not stay put. The rarest belts carry it; without containment, it decays before the hauler docks.

nodes.name: Antimatter Confinement
nodes.effect: Unlocks Antimatter synthesis and the Antimatter Drive, in the Synthesis Array
nodes.description: Penning-trap confinement at industrial scale: Exotic Matter and fusion pellets made into antimatter, and antimatter held long enough to fuel a drive.
